company.name: WeReno
company.shortDescription: AI owner's representative for commercial construction and renovations.
company.description: WeReno is an AI owner's representative that helps building owners plan and manage renovations, capital projects, and property improvements. It automatically analyzes drawings, generates scopes of work, estimates costs, prepares RFQs, coordinates vendors, and tracks project execution, giving owners the capabilities of an experienced owner's rep through software.
